1. Which protocol translates domain names into IP addresses?
A) TCP
B) DNS
C) HTTP
D) FTP
Answer: B
Explanation: DNS maps human-readable domain names to numeric IP addresses.

2. What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
A) O(1)
B) O(n)
C) O(log n)
D) O(n log n)
Answer: C
Explanation: Each comparison discards half of the remaining range.
